summary.headline: A near-dormant group: bot welcomes, occasional price gripes, one real mining chat and a moderation spat.
summary.summary: This window covers roughly two years (Nov 2024 – Sep 2026) of a very quiet channel, where the majority of messages are the Rose bot's automated welcome and departure lines plus scattered 'GM' greetings from Promanon "NTR, Onur_Chinaski (mod) and DhammaDana. Genuine conversation is rare: Royan asked about Nexa's market cap and Promanon pointed to CoinGecko (~$8.4M), while Huy8x, Khanh Nguyen84, R P and Nexa Nexa repeatedly questioned whether the group or the project is dead as the price kept sliding. Nexa Nexa also accused the team of 'only talking a good game' and complained about a ban, prompting Onur_Chinaski to explain that criticism is fine but personal attacks are not. The most substantive exchange came in August 2026, when Nexa Nexa and Quin Nguyen discussed mining economics — Quin mines ~18M NEXA/day (down from 20M+), runs at a loss on electricity but finds it better than INI, and is holding rather than selling, with Nexa Nexa mentioning an expected hardfork in about two months. Brighter notes include DhammaDana's report of meetings with officials in Sravasti about Nexa collaboration, Zhang Qian noting a sharp price rally in April 2026, and several Russian-language spam accounts drifting through.

topics.title: Bot welcomes and idle greetings
topics.summary: Most traffic is the Rose bot greeting newcomers and announcing departures, with GM exchanges from Promanon "NTR, Onur_Chinaski, DhammaDana and casual hellos from Royan, PK and Nexa Nexa.

topics.title: Mining economics and hardfork
topics.summary: Quin Nguyen told Nexa Nexa he switched from mining INI to Nexa, earns about 18 million NEXA a day (down from 20M+), is at a loss on electricity and has made only ~$300 in a month, but is holding; Nexa Nexa said a hardfork is expected in roughly two months.

topics.title: Is the project/group dead?
topics.summary: Huy8x asked whether the group had disbanded, Khanh Nguyen84 declared 'it's dead already', R P asked why Nexa keeps dropping, and Nexa Nexa said the team 'only talks a good game' and later checked whether the project was still alive.

topics.title: Moderation dispute
topics.summary: Nexa Nexa asked if user Hung had been banned and argued the group was supposed to be free; mod Onur_Chinaski replied that chatting freely does not license cursing at everyone and drew a line between criticism and personal attacks.

topics.title: Price and market cap
topics.summary: Royan asked Nexa's market cap and Promanon "NTR cited CoinGecko at $8.4M, which Royan called 'average'; much later Zhang Qian remarked that Nexa had been 'flying like crazy' for a few days.

topics.title: Outreach and external news
topics.summary: DhammaDana reported meeting a former Mandal chairman and an airport director in Sravasti to explore collaboration for Nexa; Onur_Chinaski and 💻 shared X links, and Khanh Nguyen84 joked that Pi holders are coming over to Nexa.

topics.title: Spam accounts
topics.summary: Russian-language accounts advertising weapon models and 'data services' joined and posted before leaving.

summary.mood_description: The dominant feeling is emptiness — long stretches where only the welcome bot speaks, punctuated by members asking if anyone is still there. When people do talk, the tone is skeptical or resigned: complaints about the falling price, accusations that the team only talks, and mining that runs at a loss. There are small warm patches — DhammaDana's outreach report, a brief price pump noted by Zhang Qian, and the friendly Nexa Nexa/Quin Nguyen mining chat — but nothing sustains momentum, and one exchange turns tense over a ban.

highlights.why: The one concrete data point in the window: Quin Nguyen's actual mining yield of 18M NEXA/day, down from 20M+.
Miner openly admits he's losing money on electricity — but still prefers Nexa to INI.
Mod Onur_Chinaski publicly restates the group rules after a member complains about a ban.
Rare positive project news: DhammaDana's report of meetings with local officials in Sravasti about Nexa collaboration.
Blunt two-word verdict — 'It's dead already' — that captures the recurring skepticism in the group.
